text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Oh my? I hear festival music off in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having finished shopping, Mejiro Ardan and I are strolling around town when we hear music. We follow the sound to find…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, fancy seeing the two of you here! You droppin' by for the festival, too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hello, Inari. Why yes… We were drawn here by the music, you see.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Then you go have yourselves a blast! Festivals don't happen every day, and the dancing's just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, I'd very much like to… but I'm unfamiliar with the moves of this particular dance.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Say what now? Hey, don't go sweating the small stuff. With this kinda thing, if you're havin' fun, you've already won!
choice_data_list: Let's just dance along in our own styles.
I guess… let's just copy what everyone else is doing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I suppose… the rhythm isn't too far from a waltz. If I just adjust the steps to the tempo…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Well, I'll be! Looks like you've got the knack, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Your dancing's so pretty! I wanna dance like you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see. Well then, let's give it our best attempt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff! H-hup!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Well, I'll be! Looks like you've got the knack, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Festival Veteran
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Nice form there! But we've got some nifty moves ourselves, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oho! I know that look! You went and had yourself a good old time, didn't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That I did… The hearts of strangers coming together through dance. I see now, Inari. In your eyes, festivals are—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: One and the same as winning concerts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I've always been curious as to why your winning concerts are so lively… and why my heart dances along as I watch them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And I've come to believe it may be because we all share the inherent ability to communicate with others through dance.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gee, uh… Can't say I've ever put much thought into how it all fits together like that.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe. But I love me a festival, and knowing you enjoyed that one sure puts a smile on my face!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During our time at the festival, we come to learn something about concerts!
